input.explanation: The change works without anything outside this repository changing. In main, `average_spend_per_item_this_month` in src/io_shop/spend_summary.py now returns 0 when an account has no purchases this month, where it used to raise ZeroDivisionError. Its signature and return type are the same, so `render_spend_summary` and `serve_account_page` in src/io_shop/account_page.py pick it up as they are. The flag evaluation outside this repo only supplies `use_monthly_summary`, and that needs no change. One caveat: I read main, not the deployed revision 383534e9. Whoever approves this should check that the branch that ran has the same division before treating this fix as covering it.
